title: The RC network's counterfactual family tells the loop from wrong verdict rules, and what it rests on is held
note: Stage 3. RCF1 to RCF3 are the three wrong verdict rules -- every decided hypothesis SUPPORTED, every one REFUTED, none ever decided -- which the slab family holds as CE4 to CE6: each fails both families. RCF4 to RCF7 make the judgment vacuous: an answer that is always SUPPORTED, no margin, no tie, the reference's own error ignored. RCF8 to RCF11 break the family's deployment: a case run at the documented point whatever its world asks, the family without its check table, a controller that ignores a deployment's table, a table entry nobody checks. RCF12 to RCF16 weaken the independent RK4 check: its rounding bound dropped, its Richardson estimate dropped, the coarse march answering, a step five times blunter, the producer's stated error left out of the criterion. RCF17, RCF19 and RCF20 put back AUD-024: the slow eigenvalue as a difference of near-equals, a resolution relative to the output alone, an energy balance relative to the energies alone. RCF18 was REMOVED as equivalent, not because it survived: once the slow root comes from the product of the roots, an eigenvector taken as (a12, lambda - a11) is as accurate as the product form the model uses -- across 4,500 sampled networks (ordinary, anywhere in the bounds, node 1 weakly coupled) neither comes within 1 % of the stated resolution -- so no test of the stated contract can tell them apart; the product form stays, at no cost. RCF15 survived the first run, which held no test of the check's stated step rule; test_the_check_takes_the_steps_it_states holds it now. tests/test_rc_counterfactuals.py holds each, cheapest test first.

mutations.name: RCF1_every_verdict_supported
mutations.find:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] else
                     "REFUTED" if fails[op] else "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.replace:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] or fails[op] else
                     "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.rationale: the rubber stamp: every decided hypothesis SUPPORTED

mutations.name: RCF2_every_verdict_refuted
mutations.find:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] else
                     "REFUTED" if fails[op] else "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.replace:
verdicts.add("REFUTED" if holds[op] or fails[op] else
                     "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.rationale: its mirror: every decided hypothesis REFUTED

mutations.name: RCF3_no_verdict_ever
mutations.find:
verdicts.add("SUPPORTED" if holds[op] else
                     "REFUTED" if fails[op] else "INCONCLUSIVE")
mutations.rationale: a ledger that never decides: abstention nothing justifies

mutations.name: RCF4_the_answer_is_always_supported
mutations.rationale: every world answers SUPPORTED, so the family cannot tell the rubber stamp from the loop

mutations.name: RCF5_no_margin
mutations.rationale: a case nearer its threshold than the model's error is judged as if it were clear

mutations.name: RCF6_no_tie
mutations.find: if abs(exact - threshold) + err <= RC_TIE_REL * abs(threshold):
mutations.rationale: the threshold that IS the value is never recognized: the one case where abstaining is right disappears

mutations.name: RCF7_the_reference_s_error_ignored
mutations.rationale: a world the reference cannot resolve is judged anyway

mutations.name: RCF8_the_case_runs_at_the_documented_point
mutations.rationale: the agent runs the network at the documented point whatever the case's world asks

mutations.name: RCF9_the_family_without_its_table
mutations.rationale: the family's deployment names no check for the network, so nothing is run

mutations.name: RCF10_the_controller_ignores_its_table
mutations.find: self.checks = _check_table(CHECKS if checks is None else checks)
mutations.rationale: a deployment's check table is accepted and not used

mutations.name: RCF11_a_table_entry_nobody_checks
mutations.find: if not (isinstance(m, str) and m and isinstance(c, str) and c):
mutations.rationale: a check table naming no check, or a model with none, is taken as it is

mutations.name: RCF12_the_check_ignores_its_rounding
mutations.rationale: the check states only Richardson's estimate, which understates its error once rounding dominates

mutations.name: RCF13_the_check_without_richardson
mutations.rationale: the check states no estimate of its truncation

mutations.name: RCF14_the_coarse_march_answers
mutations.rationale: the check answers with the march whose error its estimate does not describe

mutations.name: RCF15_a_blunt_check
mutations.rationale: five times fewer steps: a check too blunt to see a miss the producer's resolution forbids

mutations.name: RCF16_the_producer_s_error_left_out
mutations.rationale: a producer within its own stated resolution fails

mutations.name: RCF17_slow_root_by_difference
mutations.rationale: AUD-024: the slow eigenvalue as tr/2 + disc, which cancels when the time constants are far apart

mutations.name: RCF19_resolution_of_the_output_alone
mutations.find: sc = r["scale_K"] if UNITS[name] == "K" else scale
mutations.replace:
sc = max(abs(v), abs(p["T1_0_K"])) if UNITS[name] == "K" \
                else max(abs(r["E_in"]), abs(r["E_out"]), abs(r["E_stored"]), 1e-300)
mutations.rationale: AUD-024: a resolution relative to the output's size, not to the terms it was computed from

mutations.name: RCF20_balance_against_the_energies_alone
mutations.find:
scale = r["scale_J"] if finite and math.isfinite(r["scale_J"]) \
            else 1.0
mutations.replace:
scale = max(abs(r["E_in"]), abs(r["E_out"]), abs(r["E_stored"]),
                    1e-300) if finite else 1.0
mutations.rationale: AUD-024: the energy balance held to the energies' size, which a correct short window cannot meet

mutations.name: OV1_the_observation_keeps_the_producer_s_resolution
mutations.find:
out[name] = {**v, "resolution": max(
                v["resolution"], abs(v["value"] - vc) + rc)}
mutations.rationale: AUD-025 itself: the observation claims the producer's precision, which the check bounds only to the sum of both errors

mutations.name: OV2_the_agreement_may_narrow_the_producer
mutations.find:
out[name] = {**v, "resolution": max(
                v["resolution"], abs(v["value"] - vc) + rc)}
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: where the producer states the wider error, the observation claims more than the producer did

mutations.name: OV3_the_distance_to_the_check_is_dropped
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: a producer off the check's value by more than either error is observed as if it agreed exactly

mutations.name: OV4_the_check_s_own_error_is_dropped
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: the check's value is taken as exact, which no check states

mutations.name: OV5_outputs_nobody_compared_are_observed
mutations.find:
v["resolution"], abs(v["value"] - vc) + rc)}
    return out
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: an output the check did not compare is observed at the producer's word

mutations.name: OV6_a_report_before_the_agreement_observes_nothing
mutations.find:
if not isinstance(agree, list):
        return vals
mutations.rationale: AUD-025 migration: a history decided under admission/1 replays with no observations, every old verdict lost

mutations.name: OV7_an_unreadable_check_value_is_read
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: a NaN or infinite check value or error widens by NaN -- an interval every comparison reads as holding nothing

mutations.name: OV8_a_negative_check_error_is_read
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: a negative check error narrows the bound

mutations.name: OV9_a_boolean_is_a_check_value
mutations.replace:
def _finite(v: object) -> TypeGuard[float]:
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(v)
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: True read as a check value of 1.0

mutations.name: OV10_an_entry_of_any_shape_is_read
mutations.find:
if (isinstance(entry, list) and len(entry) == 2
                and isinstance(entry[0], str)
                and isinstance(entry[1], dict)):
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: an entry whose quantity is no object is read, and the ledger fails on it

mutations.name: RK10_the_agreement_drops_the_factor_of_safety
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: the check credits itself less error in its agreement than its criterion does

mutations.name: RK11_the_agreement_states_the_producer_s_value
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: the check states the producer's value as its own, so every observation keeps the producer's resolution

mutations.name: OV11_an_integer_no_float_holds_raises
mutations.rationale: AUD-025: a 400-digit integer in a report's agreement raises OverflowError out of the ledger's observation instead of observing nothing for that output
